review.historyPolicy: one parentless public root commit; no private branches, tags, pull requests, or commit history

candidatePayload.canonicalization: Exclude .git, every node_modules directory, release-artifacts, verification-evidence, and EXPORT-PROVENANCE.json; sort paths ordinally after replacing backslashes with forward slashes; normalize CRLF or CR to LF for text files without NUL bytes and leave binary bytes unchanged; concatenate lowercase SHA-256, two spaces, path, and LF for each file; SHA-256 the UTF-8 byte sequence.

boundary.included: npm facade, CLI, Pi extension, audited Pi compatibility runtime, public contracts, tests, legal evidence, and release automation
boundary.excluded: hosted control plane, scheduler, billing, fleet data, optimizer policy, production operations, credentials, customer data, and private source history
